regional.explanation: TEC (total electron content) measures charged particles that can slow GPS signals.
regional.missing: No recent local TEC reading is available; the local effect is unconfirmed.
regional.network: We could not check the local service that improves GPS accuracy. This does not confirm a space-weather problem.
regional.global_storm: Latest global readings show magnetic storm activity.
regional.global_watch: Space-weather checks indicate a higher risk to GPS.

effects.citizen: Disturbed signals can move a map pin away from the correct place.
effects.farmer: Disturbed signals can make tractor guidance drift from a planting or spraying line.
effects.surveyor: Disturbed signals can make precise positions take longer to settle.
effects.driver: Disturbed signals can shift map pins and pickup points.
effects.aviation: Disturbed signals can affect satellite navigation; use official aviation advisories.
effects.scientist: Changing TEC can affect GPS measurements; compare independent stations.

timing.citizen: Use maps with address and landmark checks.
timing.farmer: Start precise work once guidance holds a known line; pause if it drifts.
timing.surveyor: Begin precise work when repeated checks on a known survey point agree.
timing.driver: Continue using road signs and confirm doubtful pickup locations.
timing.aviation: Make flight decisions using official advisories and approved checks.
timing.scientist: Use measurements after their quality checks pass.

excellent.headline: No strong space-weather warning
excellent.summary: The latest checks show no strong space-weather warning. GPS accuracy still depends on your location and equipment.

moderate.headline: Check GPS before precise work
moderate.summary: Some checks suggest GPS accuracy may vary. This matters most for work that needs an exact position.

warning.headline: Take extra care with GPS
warning.summary: Current conditions may affect GPS accuracy. A GPS problem at your location has not been confirmed.

unknown.headline: Waiting for a fresh space-weather update
unknown.summary: Current readings are missing or out of date. We cannot confirm conditions right now.

action.excellent: Use maps as usual. Check the address and nearby landmarks before you travel.
action.moderate: If a map pin looks wrong, check the address and nearby landmarks.
action.warning: Confirm important locations using an address or landmarks as well as GPS.
action.unknown: Check addresses and landmarks, and look out for the next update.

action.excellent: Check your tractor's guidance before planting, spraying or marking field edges.
action.moderate: Check that your tractor follows the correct line. Pause automatic steering if it drifts.
action.warning: Check field lines carefully. Pause work that needs exact positioning if guidance becomes unreliable.
action.unknown: Check tractor guidance on a known line before starting work.

action.excellent: Check a known survey point before recording measurements.
action.moderate: Repeat measurements on known points. Accept results only after your normal accuracy checks.
action.warning: Repeat control checks. Pause precise measurements if results are inconsistent.
action.unknown: Use known survey points to check accuracy before accepting measurements.

action.excellent: Use maps as usual and follow road signs.
action.moderate: Check road signs and confirm pickup locations if the map pin looks wrong.
action.warning: Confirm pickup locations with passengers. Follow road signs if the map disagrees.
action.unknown: Follow road signs and confirm pickup locations when needed.

action.excellent: Follow official flight notices and your normal navigation checks.
action.moderate: Check official aviation space-weather notices and follow approved navigation procedures.
action.warning: Check official aviation alerts. Follow approved procedures for navigation or radio problems.
action.unknown: Use official aviation notices and approved navigation checks for flight decisions.

action.excellent: Check data quality before using today's GPS measurements.
action.moderate: Check unusual readings against other stations before drawing conclusions.
action.warning: Save unusual readings and compare independent sources before reporting a local impact.
action.unknown: Mark missing readings clearly. Wait for fresh data before describing current conditions.
